```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class TagListComponent extends Component
{
    // Public properties
    public $tags = [];
    public $tagName = '';

    // Method to store a new tag
    public function saveTag()
    {
        if ($this->tagName !== '') {
            DB::table('notes_tags')->insert(['note_id' => 1, 'name' => $this->tagName]);
            $this->tags[] = $this->tagName;
            $this->reset('tagName');
        }
    }

    // Method to delete a tag
    public function deleteTag($index)
    {
        DB::table('notes_tags')->where('id', $index)->delete();
        unset($this->tags[$index]);
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.tag-list-component');
    }
}
```
